messages:
Tariq: Opening a follow-up for yesterday's authz postmortem. Two quick symptoms: a) token checks returning OK when cache was stale, b) intermittent missing audit events from the auth-service -> pipeline. Want to capture owners and short milestones.
Nina: Saw a couple customer errors tied to this. Not high severity but customer-facing, so we should prioritize the audit visibility.
Elena: Can someone drop the log lines that show the cache hit but later validation failure? I want a concrete pattern for tests.
Tariq: pasted log samples:
```
2026-06-02T14:03:21Z auth-service token_id=xyz789 cache_state=hit token_age=42s validated=false
2026-06-02T14:03:21Z audit-emitter write_status=failed err=buffer_full
```
Nina: That token_age=42s is the smoking gun. Our fast-path assumes freshness without checking issuance timestamp.
Elena: Two parallel tracks: 1) short-term patch to make fast-path conservative; 2) make audit emission durable and observable.
Mariela: Agreed. Here's a concise action list. Reply with :+1: and ETA to accept.

ACTIONS (short):
- Patch A: conservative fast-path for token validation
  owner: Tariq
  description: require token issue_timestamp <= cache_stamp <= now and reject fast-path if token_age > 25s
  due: 2026-06-05

- Patch B: durable audit write + retry policy
  owner: Elena
  description: buffer audit events to a durable store (local RocksDB -> async forwarder or Kafka topic), add exponential retry/backoff for emitter
  due: 2026-06-12

- Observability: missing-audit alert + dashboard tile
  owner: Nina
  description: daily reconcile metric missing_audit_count per org, alert on >0 for 1h
  due: 2026-06-08

- Runbook: secrets rotation preflight checks
  owner: Mariela
  description: add pre/post rotation token probe and audit confirmation steps to rotation runbook
  due: 2026-06-07

Tariq: :+1: I'll take Patch A. ETA: small PR by EOD 6/3, deploy to staging 6/4.
Elena: :+1: I'll prototype a local durable buffer for the emitter. Initial PoC by 6/9, then infra review for Kafka/S3 option.
Nina: :+1: I'll add the dashboard panels and wire an alert to PagerDuty for any org with missing_audit_count > 0 for 1 hour. Landing by 6/8.
Mariela: I'll revise rotation playbook and include exact curl checks and expected audit keys. Planning a runbook PR on 6/6.

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-4982 "fast-path-token-safety" assigned to Tariq
ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-4983 "audit-durable-buffer" assigned to Elena
ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-4984 "missing-audit-dashboard" assigned to Nina
infra-ci: triggered CI run for branch tariq/fast-path-safety -> build queued

Tariq: Implementation notes for the fast-path test:
```
# unit test idea
issue_ts = now - 40s
cache_stamp = now - 10s
assert fast_path_allowed(issue_ts, cache_stamp) == false
```
Elena: For durability, I'm weighing options: local WAL + async forwarder vs immediate publish to Kafka with ack. Will test both latency/throughput tradeoffs.
Nina: For the reconcile metric, we need two ingest points: tokens_issued_by_org and emitted_audit_by_org with same granularity (1m). Reconcile job will run hourly and emit missing_audit_count.
Mariela: Also add an operational escalation step: if missing_audit_count > 0 for a paid org, auto-create a P1 incident channel and notify CS.

Temporary measures taken now:
- Reduced cache shortcut lifetime on all non-prod clusters to 15s
- Increased emitter worker pool by 50% for auth-service
ops-bot: Applied config change: cache_shortcut_ttl_preview=15s
ops-bot: Scaled auth-emitter workers from 4 -> 6 in preview

Elena: One more ask: add end-to-end test in the deploy pipeline that issues a token, rotates keys, and verifies that the audit event appears in the pipeline within 2 minutes. Failing that, block rollout.
Tariq: I'll add unit+integration tests around fast-path behavior and include them in presubmit.
Nina: I'll ensure dashboard has a historical view so we can detect past silent failures.
Mariela: We'll treat this as a focused 10-day mitigation sprint. I'll post weekly status updates here and mark items Done when merged. Thanks team. :pray:
